automation.icp: We sell go-to-market help and short-form clipping to startups: getting funded founders seen on LinkedIn and X by the people who buy from them. Hot = a founder, co-founder, CEO, or head of growth, marketing or sales at a startup or growing business that could buy this. Warm = could buy or refer later: investors, senior operators, consultants, coaches. Not a fit = students, job seekers, people selling to us, unrelated roles, and other clipping or GTM agencies (they are competitors).
